newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 30.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Jan. 30:
WASHINGTON - A U.S. subsidiary of pharmaceutical giant Bayer AG agreed to pay a $50 million fine for its involvement in an international conspiracy to set the prices of a widely-used additive.

WASHINGTON - When Comptroller of the Currency Eugene Ludwig showed up for a coffee with President Clinton and a gaggle of high-powered bankers at the White House last May, he says he didn't recognize everyone in the room and didn't ask their names.
WASHINGTON - The Federal Aviation Administration announced it will use the Internet to disseminate voluminous airline safety data that previously had been deemed confidential agency information.
TOKYO - The yen fell to a four-year low, while the Nikkei stock average surged three percent as investors rushed to buy shares of Japanese export companies that will benefit from a weaker yen.
